title: 模仿朗读练习（原创短文，55–70 词）
note: 题型参照深圳中考英语听说考试「模仿朗读」：先听录音，准备后朗读。短文为本应用原创。

items.title: My School Day
items.text: I get up at half past six every morning. After breakfast, I ride my bike to school with my best friend Tom. Our first class is usually English, and I really enjoy it because our teacher tells interesting stories. At noon we have lunch in the dining hall. After school, I often play basketball before I go home.

items.title: A Weekend Trip
items.text: Last Saturday, my family went to Dameisha Beach. The weather was sunny and warm, so there were lots of people there. My little sister built a sandcastle while my father and I swam in the sea. In the afternoon we had a picnic under a big tree. It was a tiring but happy day, and I hope we can go again soon.

items.title: Keeping Healthy
items.text: It is important for students to stay healthy. First, we should eat more fruit and vegetables and drink enough water every day. Second, we need to exercise for at least one hour, such as running or skipping rope. Also, going to bed early helps us feel full of energy the next day. Good habits make a big difference.

items.title: My Favourite Hobby
items.text: My favourite hobby is reading. When I was eight, my mother gave me a book about space, and since then I have loved science books. Now I read for thirty minutes before bed every night. Reading helps me learn new words and understand the world better. Sometimes I share interesting stories with my classmates, and they enjoy them too.

items.title: Saving Water
items.text: Water is very important to all of us, but many people waste it without thinking. We can save water in simple ways. For example, turn off the tap while you brush your teeth, and take shorter showers. We can also use the water from washing vegetables to water plants. If everyone does a little, we can protect this precious resource.

items.title: A Helpful Friend
items.text: Last month I was ill and missed a week of school. I was worried because I could not keep up with my lessons. Luckily, my friend Lily came to my home every afternoon. She brought me her notes and helped me with my maths homework. Thanks to her, I caught up quickly. A true friend is always there when you need help.

items.title: The School Sports Day
items.text: Our school held its sports day last Friday. All the students were excited. I took part in the one thousand metre race. At first I ran too fast and felt tired, but my classmates kept cheering for me. In the end, I finished in fourth place. Although I did not win a prize, I learned that never giving up is the most important thing.

items.title: Learning to Cook
items.text: This summer I decided to learn how to cook. My grandmother taught me to make tomato and egg noodles. At first, I cut the tomatoes too big and added too much salt. However, I kept trying and practised every weekend. Now my family says my noodles are delicious. Cooking is not easy, but it is a useful skill for everyone.

items.title: The School Library
items.text: Our school library is my favourite place on campus. It is on the third floor and has more than twenty thousand books. Every Wednesday afternoon, I go there to borrow novels and science magazines. The library is always quiet, so I can think clearly. The librarian, Mrs Chen, is very kind and often recommends good books to me.

items.title: Shenzhen Bay Park
items.text: On weekends, many families go to Shenzhen Bay Park. It stretches along the sea for about fifteen kilometres. People ride bikes, fly kites and watch birds there. In winter, thousands of birds fly from the north to spend the season here. I like walking along the path at sunset, when the sky turns orange and the sea shines.

items.title: A Rainy Morning
items.text: This morning it rained heavily, and the streets were full of water. I put on my raincoat and walked to the bus stop. The bus was late, so I waited for almost twenty minutes. When I finally arrived at school, my shoes were wet. My teacher lent me a pair of slippers, and I felt warm again.

items.title: Learning English
items.text: Learning English is not easy, but I enjoy it. Every morning I read aloud for ten minutes, and in the evening I listen to English songs. I also keep a small notebook for new words. When I make mistakes, I try not to feel shy. My teacher says that speaking a lot is the best way to improve.

items.title: My Grandfather
items.text: My grandfather is seventy years old, but he is still very active. He gets up at six every morning and practises tai chi in the park. After breakfast, he reads the newspaper and waters his flowers. He often tells me stories about his childhood in the countryside. I think he is the wisest person in our family.

items.title: The Dragon Boat Festival
items.text: The Dragon Boat Festival comes in May or June every year. On this day, people eat zongzi, which are made of sticky rice wrapped in leaves. In many cities, teams race dragon boats on rivers while crowds cheer loudly. The festival reminds us of Qu Yuan, a famous poet who lived more than two thousand years ago.

items.title: A Science Experiment
items.text: Yesterday we did an interesting experiment in our science class. First, we put a raw egg into a glass of clean water, and it sank to the bottom. Then we added some salt to the water and stirred it. Slowly, the egg began to rise. Our teacher explained that salt water is heavier than fresh water.

items.title: Taking the Metro
items.text: Shenzhen has a large metro system, and I take it to visit my aunt every month. The trains are clean and fast, and they come every few minutes. During rush hours, the carriages can be very crowded, so people should queue patiently. I always give my seat to older people, because it is a polite thing to do.

items.title: My Pet Cat
items.text: We have a pet cat called Mimi. She has soft white fur and big green eyes. Mimi likes to sleep in the sun on the balcony, and she often follows me around the house. When I do my homework, she sometimes sits on my desk and watches me. Taking care of her has taught me to be responsible.

items.title: Planting Trees
items.text: Last March, our class went to a hill near the city to plant trees. Each group carried young trees, spades and buckets of water. We dug holes, put the trees in and covered the roots with soil. It was hard work, and we were all covered in mud. However, we felt proud because we had done something good for the environment.

items.title: Using Phones Wisely
items.text: Mobile phones are very useful, but spending too much time on them is harmful. Some students play games until midnight and feel tired the next day. I have made a rule for myself: I only use my phone for thirty minutes after finishing my homework. This way, I have more time for reading, sports and talking with my family.

items.title: A Visit to the Museum
items.text: During the holiday, my father took me to the Shenzhen Museum. We saw old tools, coins and photos that showed how the city changed from a small fishing village into a modern city. I was surprised to learn how quickly it had grown. The visit helped me understand the hard work of the people who built Shenzhen.
